focus_areas: Structural integrity of the overhead machinery and beams
Boundary definition of human figures against the complex background
Consistency of lighting and shadows given the strong backlight

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the human figures. In AI-generated industrial scenes, humans often suffer from limb fusion or lack of detail. Also, scrutinize the hanging machinery: does it have a physically plausible connection to the ceiling beams, or does it appear to float or melt into them? The global blur is a confounding factor; distinguish between photographic motion blur and AI 'smearing'.
image_description: An interior view of an industrial facility, likely a sawmill or lumber processing plant. The scene features a large wooden beam structure overhead with hanging machinery (possibly a carriage or hoist). In the foreground and mid-ground, there are tracks or rails on the floor, stacks of processed lumber planks, and raw logs. Two human figures are visible: one on the left wearing blue pants and a dark jacket, and another further back on the right. Bright light floods in from a large opening in the background, creating high contrast and some overexposure.
